model_notes: Audio is the notable gotcha on this generation: the HDA controller binds snd_hda_intel but the CS8409 codec is silent until an out-of-tree driver is installed (see the audio subsystem).
FaceTime HD ('EyeSight') camera works. It is not a PCI device, so the collectors do not match it to a component record.
Thunderbolt 3 (thunderbolt driver) is detected and binds.
Being a Polaris GPU (DisplayPort 1.4 / HBR3), this model has the bandwidth for native 5K, unlike the 2015 iMac17,1 — but the reported machines ran 4K and did not configure 5K.
